newsitem.title: USA: Cambridge SoundWorks Inc Q3 net increases.
newsitem.headline: Cambridge SoundWorks Inc Q3 net increases.

text.p: NOTE: Cambridge SoundWorks said its third quarter period ended March 30.

Cambridge SoundWorks said that as a result of the acquisition in February 1997 whereby Creative Technologies Ltd, the parent company, acquired an approximate 20 percent interest in Cambridge SoundWorks, Creative Technologies received 912,294 shares of common stock together with a warrant to purchase an additional 257,314 shares of common stock. This brings the shares issued and outstanding to 3,801,693 and accounts for the increase in weighted average number of shares and share equivalents outstanding in the third quarter of 1997 as compared to the same period a year ago.
